content.short: Symbiosis is a cross-chain AMM DEX pooling liquidity from EVM and non-EVM chains into one unified protocol for seamless multi-chain swaps.
content.description: Symbiosis Finance is a cross-chain decentralized exchange that pools liquidity from multiple blockchain networks  including both EVM and non-EVM chains  to enable seamless multi-hop swaps between any token on any supported chain in a single transaction. Symbiosis uses relayers and atomic swaps for trustless cross-chain settlement, connecting Mantle to a broad ecosystem of chains including Bitcoin-adjacent networks. This makes it one of the most interoperable swap protocols available.
